elements.description: Streaming JSON as a collapsible, typed tree, checked against a JSON Schema as it arrives.

properties.name: text
properties.description: The JSON as it arrives – it may grow every frame and stop mid-value. A ```json fence around it is ignored

properties.name: schema
properties.description: A JSON Schema to check the value against as it arrives (the common keywords – see the docs); unset checks syntax only

properties.name: streaming
properties.description: The text is still coming in: a caret blinks at the end, and what hasn't arrived isn't flagged yet

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the tree's accessible name

properties.name: collapsed
properties.description: JSON Pointer paths of folded branches ("/items/0"). Changed by the user unless tc-collapsed-change is prevented

properties.name: variableName
properties.description: The variable name in "Copy as TypeScript": `const output = { … };`

properties.name: maxHeight
properties.description: Cap the tree's height in px (0: grow with the value); a capped tree scrolls and follows the end while streaming

properties.name: value
properties.description: The value parsed so far (fields still arriving are left out); undefined before anything has arrived

properties.name: issues
properties.description: Everything the schema check found so far, in document order

properties.name: syntaxError
properties.description: Where the text stopped being JSON, if it did

properties.name: complete
properties.description: The value has arrived in full: its outermost bracket closed

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-collapsed-change
events.description: A branch was folded or opened ({ collapsed: string[] } – JSON Pointer paths); cancelable

events.name: tc-copy
events.description: The value was copied ({ format: "json" | "ts", text: string })

events.name: tc-validate
events.description: The text settled (not streaming) and its result changed ({ valid, value, issues, error, complete })

functions.name: structuredOutputParse
functions.description:
Parses JSON that may still be arriving, tolerantly, as tc-structured-output does – for elements that render
structured answers as they stream (tc-generated-ui). `final` says no more text is coming

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the tree's accessible name

props.name: collapsed
props.description: JSON Pointer paths of folded branches, e.g. "/items/0" (controlled)

props.name: defaultCollapsed
props.description: Folded branches to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onCollapsedChange
props.description: Called with the folded paths each time a branch is folded or opened

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called after a copy, with the format ("json" or "ts") and the text that went to the clipboard

props.name: onValidate
props.description: Called once the text settles (not streaming) with the check's result: valid, value, issues, syntax error
